# telnyx_porting_order_action_requirement_initiate (Action)

Starts an action requirement of a porting order.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `params` (Attributes) Required information for initiating the action requirement for AU ID verification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--params))
- `porting_order_id` (String) The porting order id.

<a id="nestedatt--params"></a>
### Nested Schema for `params`

Required:

- `first_name` (String) The first name of the person that will perform the verification flow.
- `last_name` (String) The last name of the person that will perform the verification flow.
